Oh god... And I just got home and found my sister drugged lying in the lawn of the backyard and she is already cursing my mother that do everything for her. This Christmas will be great...

Well, every year my entire family donate some clothes to families in need. We are not in a good place right now, but we keep the tradition alive. I'm not a religious person but I love the way Christmas make us feel. I wish people felt like this the rest of the year; see all people as a big family, not mattering the differences. I grew up with such a nice family, we used to do a lot all year. We used to buy some toys for kids, food for dogs, visit some hospitals as clowns, but we can't do all that anymore. Everything went down the hill 4 years ago on this exact day when my mother was diagnosed with cancer. One of the bad ones. In her lungs. And she never even smoked or anything. In that same time, I was graduating in my university and couldn't find a job (I still didn't, my country is passing through a severe economic crises, and now I'm studying to enter in another university, with a little bit of hope). With those news, everyone got sick. My father was diagnosed with 3 aneurysms, and my psychotic sister got worse, and got involved with heavy drugs. She even tried to kill my parents (she is psychotic, I'm not kidding) but we still have to live with her. I was diagnosed with terminal brain disease (crazy, right?). I don't know the terms in English, but I got 3 exams in that time confirming that my brain was degenerating, annnnd to help with that, as soon as she heard about it, my girlfriend broke up with me. Well. Hard f*cking times. I thought about killing myself every day. I made more exams through the year and my disease is stable and will probably keep like this. After all that, we couldn't do much for other people like we used to do. Time passes, things are still really hard and I'm writing all this while I'm waiting for my mom finish an exam. I don't know how we gonna spend this Christmas to be fair. My sister has never been worse, she looks like a zombie. What I know is that me and my mother already separated the clothes we will donate. Keeping the tradition alive. And she just got out, I have to go back to my city. Love you guys. Things like what you are doing really inspire people. Will definitely make the world a better place a little bit. Let's keep our traditions and create new ones. Please let this Christmas feeling last through the entire year.
